scope: Stage 3 native ownership controller and bootstrap-only physical target: complete E820/reservation normalization, source-derived identity budgets, exact metadata deltas, live opaque token release/pins, canonical Nat checks, actual privileged physical zeroing/reuse and failed reserved-zero poison preservation. Eleven target VM observations per cohort include real E820 map compared to the independent reference model, controlled sparse/unaligned handoffs, duplicate creation, IF/stack refusal and malformed/unsupported maps. Component call/stack inspection excludes the actual owning gateway, complete caller/fatal retirement and source/native/load publication. Production root/dynamic workload integration, distribution, containers and VM hosting remain unqualified. Legacy component VM observations remain clean-room static-ELF ABI fixture scope, not new BusyBox acceptance.
